verdict.rationale: Ironclad's docs describe contract creation via No-Code Builder and Workflow Designer, but no evidence describes guided questionnaires that flag specific answers for attorney review — community comments (ironclad-comm-9) even raise concern about templates lacking legal review/malpractice safeguards rather than confirming such a feature. Missing for 10: any documentation of a guided Q&A flow, attorney-review flagging logic, or founder-facing legal correctness checks.
